name: Backup, Replication and High Availability
summary: What stands between an incident and a resignation letter: a backup that restores, a replica that takes over and a plan that was rehearsed.
prerequisites: Requires administration. This is the course that separates a database that survives from one that has been lucky.
syllabus: Full, incremental and continuous backup, and where each one fails

Streaming and logical replication, synchronous or not
Disaster recovery and a runbook that outlives the person who wrote it
